comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The journalistic depth of this script is outstanding. It is fascinating to learn that the ".tv" domain (which powers massive platforms like Twitch) brings in about 1/12th of their entire national income just to keep the lights on and build seawalls [22:43]. The concept of Tuvalu literally backing up its entire sovereignty, maps, and heritage into the cloud to become the world's first digital nation [21:01] is one of the most profound and heartbreaking geopolitical strategies of our time. Exceptional research! 👏

comments.text: 🏝 What touched me most is how the people of Tuvalu remain determined to preserve their language, culture, and identity despite the uncertainty about their homeland's future.
